question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Finance processes do not live in one system. They run across ERPs, portals, spreadsheets and inboxes that do not connect cleanly. People move data and resolve the same exceptions by hand every month.

Zalos AI Workers operate those systems the way a finance team does, with tighter controls, accuracy and auditability, using a finance-specific agent harness & skill library.

**WHY FINANCE TEAMS CHOOSE ZALOS** 

1\. ZERO SYSTEM INTEGRATION 

AI Workers log in and use your systems through the user interface, as your team does. There are no API integrations to build and no software to replace. 

2\. TRANSPARENT DECISIONING 

Decisions follow deterministic rules, not model judgement. Decision logic, inputs and controls are traceable and ready for audit, with linked workbooks and timestamped run logs behind every entry. 

3\. OUTCOME-BASED PRICING

ROI secured by Zalos solving last-mile work, then customer starts subscription when criteria met.

# **The Blockers ➜ Your Finance Systems:**

Finance Operations is buried in repetitive tasks, driving:

❌ **Lack of financial visibility** for decision-making

❌ **Wasted time** by in-house or outsourced teams

❌ **Mistakes** and **delays** from human-driven processes

Barriers to FinOps automation have included:

🚨 **Legacy ERPs** with limited AI

🚨 **Authentication-protected** websites & portals

🚨 **Too many Finance Systems** that don’t speak to one another

It doesn’t have to be this way.

# **The Breakthrough ➜ Zalos:**

Zalos Agents run your rule-based processes, using your existing Finance applications:

⭐ Our agents **automate processe**s based on **simple instructions** (e.g., Screen Recording, PDFs)

⭐ **Native handling of ERPs** or other applications (e.g., 2FA, Captcha)

⭐ **Superior Finance & Accounting task performance**, including leveraging our **FinOps libraries** (e.g., System Access, Categorization, Reconciliation, etc.)

**FROM:** In the Bay Area, a Finance Manager was wasting 4 days (!) per month:

✖️ Downloads transactions from Corporate Credit Cards & legacy Banks

✖️ Uploads into NetSuite and manually categorizes 100s of transactions

**USING ZALOS:** Finance Manager schedules ‘run process’ weekly:

✔️ Zalos handles 2FA to download & submit required transactions

✔️ Zalos operates NetSuite to categorize >60% outstanding transactions

No browser required: Zalos works silently in the background, continuously improving itself.

Gaining 1 day per week was transformational. The Finance Manager could:

🟪 Reduce financial risks with closer inspection (e.g., debt covenants)

🟪 Catch cash leakages by spotting suppliers being paid at generous terms

🟪 Be a strategic partner to the CEO & business with better analysis
